map.由两物体速度求相对速度 使用指南: Relative Velocity from Two Object Velocities User Guide
map.输入同一直线上两物体速度 v₁、v₂，按 v_rel = v₁ − v₂ 计算它: Enter the velocities v₁ and v₂ of two objects on the same line and compute their relative velocity as v_rel = v₁ − v₂, which is a direct way to judge overtaking and meeting problems and reference frame changes in one-dimensional kinematics.
map.输入两物体速度 v₁、v₂，求相对速度。: Enter the velocities v₁ and v₂ of two objects to get their relative velocity.
map.同直线两物体相对速度。: The relative velocity of two objects on the same straight line.
map.求同一直线上两个物体的相对速度，判断追及与相遇。: Find the relative velocity of two objects on the same line and judge overtaking and meeting.
map.：v_r = 30−20 = 10 m/s。即前者相对后者以 10 m/s 靠近: v_r = 30−20 = 10 m/s. That is, the former approaches or separates from the latter at 10 m/s.
map.前车 25 m/s，后车 32 m/s: The lead car is at 25 m/s and the following car at 32 m/s
map.：v_rel=v₁−v₂=25−32=−7.000 m/s。若定义 v₁ 为前车: v_rel=v₁−v₂=25−32=−7.000 m/s. Taking v₁ as the lead car, a negative value means the lead car is moving backwards relative to the following car, that is the following car is catching up.
map.由每分钟转数求角速度: Angular velocity from revolutions per minute
map.由初速度与减速度求制动时间: Braking time from initial speed and deceleration
map.反向怎么算？: How do I work it backwards?
map.取同向为正，反向则一正一负，v_r = v₁−v₂ 仍成立；结果为负表示反向远离: Take the same direction as positive and the opposite direction as one positive and one negative, and v_r = v₁−v₂ still holds; a negative result means moving apart in the opposite direction.
map.符号的正负该怎么理解？: How should I interpret the sign?
map.正负取决于你把谁当作参考物。工具按 v_rel=v₁−v₂ 计算：结果为正说明物: Whether the result is positive or negative depends on which object you treat as the reference. The tool computes v_rel=v₁−v₂: a positive result means object 1 is moving away from object 2 in the positive direction. In practice, fix the positive direction first and then substitute both velocities with their signs.
